title: pinus insularis var. langbianensis
intro: Pinus insularis var. langbianensis, commonly known as the Langbian Island Pine, is a variety of evergreen coniferous tree that belongs to the Pinaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Vietnamese medicine to treat various health conditions due to its impressive array of health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Pinus insularis var. langbianensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
